newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle markets remain quiet - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle markets remain quiet - trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets remained quiet late Wednesday as feedlot managers passed $63.00 per cwt bids.
A small Texas meat packer paid $64.00 for a few cattle Wednesday, but the major meat packing companies held bids at $63.00, sources said.
Managers continue to price cattle at $64.00. Some Texas and Oklahoma managers said they would like to sell more this week to empty their showlists.
Early Wednesday, several Kansas feedlot managers had expected $64.00 bids after receiving and passing several $63.00 bids from the major meat packers. But the buyers did not raise the bids.
Kansas and Texas feedlot sources said there were several instances of packers taking delivery Wednesday of cattle they bought Tuesday.
